note: SYNTHETIC assessments for the pick eval (0110-10-15, the real-data gate fix), written by the worker: for each posting the requirement rows a stored assessment would hold (the posting's own lines), each with its status, its class and its evidence QUOTES. A quote is words of a line of the synthetic master (master.md, or a line variations.json adds), or a rewording of one; the eval traces it to master line ids with the product's own rule (assess_master.cited_requirements), so a quote of a line a master size does not hold cites nothing there. 'shapes' names the cases the gate found missing: a cited line that shares no word with its requirement, a cited line in an older role that is the only evidence, two lines that carry the same words of which one is cited, a cited line that is long, one line cited for four rows.
